[EN] Don't give an opening to your opponent when fighting with a sword. Always observe your opponent's movements and stay alert and light footed to evade attacks.

Defeating the enemy with fluid and sharp movements is what us swordsmen are trained to do.
[ES] No le des una apertura a tu oponente al pelear con una espada. Siempre observa los movimientos de tu oponente y mantente alerta y con pasos ligeros para evadir ataques.

Derrotar al enemigo con movimientos fluidos y precisos es para lo que nos entrenan a los espadachines.
